verification.note: Observer mean averages shard means, not a request-weighted CUDA timing.

plan.phase_method: Five midpoint phases, deterministically permuted per batch; fractional event count allocated over repeats.
plan.rounding: Across five repeats: nearest integer to B/10, ties upward; maximum mean-count error 0.1.
plan.cache: Reset per trial; warm B backgrounds and ceil(B/50) independent interferer histories in EVERY condition.
plan.primary: Mean request (last-first token arrival)/127, then mean over five repeats; includes zero-event repeats.
plan.event: Actual first prefill schedule anchored; widths 1/5/16 and chunks, exact ordinal-matched baseline; report event/sample counts.
plan.interpretation: Work-normalized injection, not fixed arrivals/second; dense sampling does not establish a fixed-event hardware slope.
plan.failures: Retain and stop; no inference retries, no batch reduction, no selection by expected trend
plan.evidence: Verified compressed raw archives per paired group; export and drain observer between idle groups only.
